matchup.plan_title: Plan (08:00 UTC 18 Nov, after the 17 Nov games)
matchup.plan_md:
**Where things stand:**
- **Score:** **543 to 404**, up 139.
- **Projection with no more moves:** **1,885 to 1,589**.
- **Adds:** 2 of 7 used, **5 left**.
- **ESPN sync:** no roster moves. Elsewhere, Jared McCain was picked up and Keldon Johnson dropped.
- Bey stays while Murphy is out, as the user asked. The slots rotated are Gobert's and Bamba's.

**The three safe moves** (+84.6; ESPN dates, Melbourne deadlines):
1. **20 Nov:** Gobert → **Derik Queen** (NO @OKC), by 12:00 PM Sat 21.
2. **21 Nov:** Bamba → **Neemias Queta** (BOS @SAC), by 2:00 PM Sun 22.
3. **22 Nov:** Queen → **Aday Mara** (OKC @MIA), by 10:00 AM Mon 23.

**Two conditional moves** add about 32 more (+117.1 with all five):
- **19 Nov: Bamba → Zach Edey** (MEM vs GSW), by 12:00 PM Fri 20. Only if Memphis's 19 Nov report clears him.
  - 19 Nov is the second night of a back-to-back, and he has not played both nights of one this season.
  - He returned from ankle injury management on 16 Nov ([CBS, 16 Nov](https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/grizzlies-zach-edey-questionable-for-monday-539293/)).
  - If he sits, the same slot goes to **Myles Turner** (MIL vs POR) for +116.4. Turner is also a second-night risk (`--sit "Zach Edey@2026-11-19"`).
- **20 Nov: Edey → Quentin Grimes** (LAL), by 2:00 PM Sat 21. Only if Austin Reaves is still out.
  - Grimes starts "as long as Reaves is out" ([NBC Sports, 17 Nov](https://www.nbcsports.com/fantasy/basketball/player-news/2026-11-17/redick-reaves-to-test-injured-heel-wednesday)).
  - Reaves tests his heel on 18 Nov; *ESPN est.* 18 Nov.
  - Grimes's rate (36.9) leans on two starts: L7 59.0 (2), a **small sample**.

**Form:**

| Player | Rate | Season | L7 | L15 | L30 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Zach Edey | 27.4 | 25.1 (11) | 28.0 (2), small sample | 26.7 (6) | 25.1 (11) |
| Quentin Grimes | 36.9 | 23.2 (13) | 59.0 (2), small sample | 29.3 (6) | 23.2 (13) |

Grimes's L7 is +35.8, on 39.5 min as a starter with Reaves out.

**Injuries:**
- **Kawhi Leonard:** out at least another week. The Raptors say he has "progressed in his strength and conditioning program", with the next update in a week ([Bleacher Report, 17 Nov](https://bleacherreport.com/articles/25534761-kawhi-leonard-injury-update-raptors-give-latest-return-timeline-amid-stars-rehab-knee)). *ESPN est.* 27 Nov.
- **Jalen Duren** (IR): re-evaluated about 22 Nov; *ESPN est.* 24 Nov.
- **Jaylen Brown** (Snow Time Lakers): out, hamstring; no timetable reported; *ESPN est.* 21 Nov.

**Lineup on 18 Nov:** 11 of ours play for 10 slots. Bench Mo Bamba, and keep Kawhi out of the starting lineup.
